OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the March 31, 2023, April 30, 2023 and May 31, 2023 financial statements.
Financial Statements
5.
RECEIVE A REPORT ON STAFF’S APPROACH TO REVISE THE ADOPTED FY 2023-2024 BUDGET; RECEIVE A REPORT FROM THE FINANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE; AND APPROVE THE PROPOSED BUDGET CALENDAR
Recommendation: Receive a report on staff’s approach to revising the Fiscal Year 2023-2024 adopted budget, receive a report on the recommendations of the Finance Advisory Committee, and approve the proposed budget calendar.
Staff Report
6.
ADOPTION OF PROPOSED RESOLUTION R23-29 ESTABLISHING THE GANN APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT AT $34,730,093 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2023-24
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt proposed resolution R23-29 establishing the Appropriations Limit for the City of Palos Verdes Estates for Fiscal Year 2023-24 at $34,730,093.
Staff Report
7.
RECEIVE AND FILE AN UPDATE ON THE PRIORITY LIST FOR FIRE SAFETY WEED ABATEMENT SERVICES AND LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE SERVICES
Recommendation: That the City Council receive and file an update on the priority list for fire safety weed abatement services and landscape maintenance services.
Staff Report
PUBLIC HEARING/ORDINANCE
NEW BUSINESS
8.
CONSIDER CONTINUING MEMBERSHIP WITH LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA CITIES (CAL CITIES) AND APPROVE MEMBERSHIP FEE OF $7,860 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2023-2024
Recommendation: Approve as presented.
Staff Report
9.
DISCUSS REVENUE OPTIONS TO REPLACE MEASURE E
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council discuss potential sources to replace the revenue provided by the Palos Verdes Estates Measure E scheduled to sunset in Fiscal Year 2026-2027 and provide direction to staff. The Council may direct staff to research and bring back options for retaining a consultant to assist in evaluating options for a ballot measure, or other funding sources. The Council may also choose to direct the Finance Advisory Committee to work with staff on these issues.
Staff Report
Supplemental Staff Report
10.
MALAGA COVE AREA REPORTS OF WATER INTRUSION
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council: (1) Adopt a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates, California appropriating $40,000 in Unencumbered General Fund Balance (Fund 01); (2) Authorize the City Manager or the City Attorney to procure and execute an agreement, in a form approved by both, to investigate potential sources of water intrusion and solutions in an amount not to exceed $20,000; and (3) Authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 1 to the Agreement with NV5 for water sampling and testing services in an amount not to exceed $20,000 for a total contract amount not to exceed $26,000.
Staff Report
Correspondence
11.
ON-GOING LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE PLAN
Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council consider two options for on-going landscape maintenance and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
12.
APPROVE RESOLUTION 23-31, UPDATING RESOLUTION R22-28 SETTING TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR POLICE MANAGEMENT EMPLOYEES
Recommendation: Approve Resolution 23-31 updating Resolution 22-28 setting terms and conditions for police management employees.
